terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.section1Text: By accessing and using the OnChoice platform, you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, do not use the platform.
terms.section2Text: You must be at least 18 years old to use this platform. By creating an account, you declare that you have the legal capacity to enter into binding contracts.
terms.section3Text: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account. Do not share your credentials. The platform is not responsible for unauthorized access resulting from user negligence.
terms.section4Text: Prediction markets are based on real events. Resolution is done by the platform team based on public and verifiable sources. Resolution decisions are final.
terms.section5Text: Deposits are processed via PIX. The platform processes withdrawals within 24 business hours. Minimum amounts may apply.
terms.section6Text: It is prohibited to: manipulate markets, use multiple accounts, launder money, or engage in any illegal activity. Violations result in permanent ban and loss of funds.
terms.section7Text: The platform does not guarantee profits. Bets involve risk of loss. Only use funds you can afford to lose. Past results do not guarantee future results.
terms.section8Text: Your personal data is protected under LGPD. We do not share information with third parties without your consent, except when required by law.
terms.section9Text: OnChoice reserves the right to change these terms at any time. Significant changes will be communicated through the platform.
